Welcome to TALVIS! The navigation bar on the left gives you quick access to all modules. Let's take a quick look at what's available.
Your personal dashboard with customizable widgets — get a quick overview of what matters most to you.
Manage your companies and contacts. Track relationships, communication history, and standing orders.
Plan and track marketing activities, campaigns, and prospect pipelines.
Create and manage projects, milestones, planning boards, and team assignments.
Handle invoices, quotes, and payment tracking. Full billing workflow from draft to payment.
Browse and manage your product catalogue including pricing and availability.
HR module: manage your team, vacation requests, absences, and working hours.
A unified calendar view for events, deadlines, and appointments across all modules.
Access your personal profile, preferences, notification settings, and account details.

Your customer universe is waiting to be built. Add your first company and start mapping the relationships, projects, and revenue that will define your success.
Use the filter panel to narrow down your customer list by project status, creation date, last update, revenue, or assigned product.
Create a new company by entering a name — or simply paste a website URL. TALVIS will automatically try to parse the company's imprint page to fill in address, contact details, and more.

Known Sequitur is your comprehensive call management interface for handling customer interactions while on the phone. It provides everything you need during a call: add new projects and leads, update existing project information, capture additional contact details and employees, view important customer statistics, and identify missing information (like birthdays or lead sources) so you can ask the caller directly.

This is your personal dashboard. You can arrange it individually with widgets to keep the most relevant information at a glance.
Click the edit icon in the toolbar to enter edit mode. Once active, you can rearrange, add, and remove widgets on your dashboard.
In edit mode, you can rename your dashboards by clicking their title, and add new dashboards to organize different views for different contexts.
In edit mode, the panel on the right shows all available widgets. Simply drag one onto your dashboard to add it.
Most objects in TALVIS support right-click context menus with quick actions. You can easily spot them — their background turns teal when you hover over them.
Context-aware objects support multi-selection just like in Windows Explorer. Use Ctrl+Click to add items to your selection, and Shift+Click to select a range up to that item.

Drop files here to build your marketing asset library. Supports images, videos, documents and more.
Your marketing asset library is organized into categories — brand assets, social media content, email templates, presentations, and more. Select a category to browse its files.
Search assets by name or by tags. Tags help you cross-reference files across different categories — for example finding all assets tagged 'Q1 2025'.
Simply drag and drop files onto the upload zone to add them to the selected category. Images, videos, PDFs, and other document types are all supported.

Create your first marketing initiative to get started.
Describe the goals and scope of this initiative...
An initiative is a concrete marketing campaign or project — for example 'LinkedIn Q1 Outreach'. It contains a group of prospects and runs one or more workflow templates to engage them.
Filter your initiatives by status: active (running), paused (temporarily stopped), or completed. The badge on each initiative shows how many prospects are enrolled.
Click + to start a new initiative. Give it a name, set its status, then open it to add prospects, attach a workflow, and track activities and KPI progress.
e.g., Email Open Rate, Revenue Generated

KPIs are the key indicators you want to track across your marketing activities. Define metrics once here — they are then automatically tracked and aggregated across all activities in your initiatives.
Filter by metric type: counters (absolute numbers), percentages, conversion rates, currency amounts, or time durations. Each type formats its value and progress bar accordingly.

Workflows are reusable activity templates — a predefined sequence of tasks (emails, calls, follow-ups) that you can apply to multiple initiatives. Define a process once, reuse it everywhere.
Click the + button to create a new workflow template. Give it a name and description, then open it to add individual activity steps. Active workflows can be attached to any initiative.

Show an orange warning badge on a project as soon as the predicted final effort reaches this share of the estimated work.
Send an email to the project manager when hours invested divided by estimated work exceeds a threshold. Notifications reset automatically if the ratio drops below the threshold again.

Define global default payment plans by project budget size. Tiers are evaluated in order — the first tier whose threshold exceeds the project's net value is used. The last tier (no threshold) serves as the catch-all. Use [payment-plan] in quote text to insert the plan.
